Technical review was conducted regarding the calibration script used by [p1]. It was determined that when calculating data for production staging, the final parameter in the `getCalibrationSignalLimit` function must be set to 0 (instead of 1).

[me] confirmed that the signal limit of 89 for Mexico had been explicitly added to the calibration settings and that the category assignment was completed.
decisions: Set signal limit (sl) to 89 for staging in Mexico.
Assign 'bus shelter' category to all locations in Mexico.
